chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him), he said it upon reciting it:
Therein declare glory unto Him in the mornings and the evenings; Men whom neither merchandise nor any sale diverteth from the remembrance of Allah.
ai.seo_question: Who are the men not distracted by trade from the remembrance of Allah?
ai.summary: In this exegesis from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elucidates the verse describing men whose hearts are anchored in divine remembrance despite the distractions of commerce. This highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the balance between worldly engagement and spiritual presence, where trade does not negate piety but is subordinated to the consciousness of God. The commentary underscores the ideal state of the faithful who maintain inner tranquility and focus amidst the bustle of daily life.
